title: Package manifest (yg-package.yaml)
description: Package manifest (yg-package/1) — name, version, requires.yg, the rules it ships, their settings. Read from <package directory>/yg-package.yaml. A key not listed is ignored by this reader (the /1 rule), so additionalProperties is true.

name.description: The package name, one path segment; the directory it installs under.

yg.description: The Yggdrasil versions the package runs on (e.g. "6.x"); checked when it is installed.

aspects.description: The rule directories beside the manifest, each one path segment; every directory must be declared and every declared one present.

config.description: The settings each rule reads through ctx.config, with their types and defaults.

type.description: The type a consumer's value must have.

default.description: The value the rule reads until a consumer adapts it; of the declared type.
